countingUnit: 13 repair packages R00–R12; these cover 18 feature batches B01–B18. A package may contain several tasks.

packages.title: Reconcile scope and evidence
packages.note: Scope ledger exists; dynamic host-resolution evidence is incomplete.
acceptance: Every B01–B18 requirement has an item ID, accountable owner role, dependency and measurable exit test; solved items link to current evidence.
Historical receipts remain available; no completion percentage is inferred from file counts or green jobs.

packages.title: Repair production identity safely
packages.note: Original 192-row identity repair accepted. Broader quarantined catalog review belongs to R02; runtime activation belongs to R06/R09.
acceptance: No unintended new role, tenant, operation or artifact authority; existing denials and legitimate grants are preserved.
Unchanged identity guard passes without quarantine replacement or bypass; independent readback matches the approved row-level proposal.

packages.title: Map existing service contracts before building replacements
packages.note: 187 candidates indexed; action-level contract and authority review remains.
acceptance: A requirement-to-contract matrix covers every business action with real source and authority evidence or an explicit blocker.
No fabricated API, screen, workflow, provider entitlement or business data.

packages.title: Make verified publication reliable
packages.note: Immutable-source publication works; full authenticated smoke and rollback acceptance remain.
acceptance: One candidate can progress from verification to publication without source drift; both current-main checks remain effective.
Deployment receipts and a smoke login/action/reload journey refer to the same source; rollback restores a compatible known-good API/UI pair.

packages.title: Finish one real web shell before portal-wide rollout
packages.note: Tenant pilot and locale/recovery subsets work; shell migration and localization/RTL acceptance remain.
acceptance: Actual login, navigation/deep link, theme/layout change, action, reload and logout pass at narrow/wide breakpoints.
Denied destinations never open; dirty/pending forms, overlays and stale account callbacks retain correct behavior; EN/FR/ES labels and LTR/RTL are checked.
evidence: CI 41349589267: 16 tenant-host checks including 2 locale cases

packages.title: Mount native hosts progressively
packages.note: Real native host rollout and physical-device journeys are not accepted.
acceptance: A real native app reaches the new shell after login and its actions traverse the intended API/data/reload path.
Android/iOS build and actual-device checks cover focus, touch/drag, permissions, orientation, suspend/resume and account switching; desktop parity checks stay green.

packages.title: Complete preferences and durable recovery
packages.note: Tenant draft and pending-request recovery are implemented; global API777 hosts, dashboard persistence and broader native recovery remain.
acceptance: Owned save/read/reload/cross-device restoration and dashboard persistence pass with independent SQL readback.
Crash/restart at every mutation boundary cannot duplicate a write or restore another actor’s data; revoked access remains denied and failed drafts stay recoverable.

packages.title: Complete data controls and configurable widgets
packages.note: Editor and dashboard-remount subsets pass; full control/widget adoption and persistence remain.
acceptance: Each required control has a real authorized host, persistence/remove/readback flow and accessible web/native behavior.
Dashboard layout survives reload and recovery without stale or unauthorized widgets; overlapping business counts are not presented as additive totals.
evidence: Dashboard repair source 751581a1b234a33545750b163dc43225f6b3fbf7; CI results tracked separately

packages.title: Complete the work applications
packages.note: Remaining work-app domain behavior and complete owned journeys are not accepted.
acceptance: Create/read/update/delete or approved state transitions persist and survive fresh-session reload, with concurrency and tenant/role denial.
Recurrence/timezone changes, reminders and board ordering meet explicit domain rules rather than only rendering fixture data.

packages.title: Complete communications and files
packages.note: Messaging role policy is staged; host, provider, member/tenant denial and file-lifecycle acceptance remain.
acceptance: Actual send/receive/read/unread/history and file lifecycle flows work through UI, provider/service, database and reload.
Wrong-owner, denied-role and cross-tenant tests pass; no provider acceptance is misreported as recipient delivery.

packages.title: Complete application and financial families
packages.note: Application/finance business journeys and replacement of unavailable placeholders remain.
acceptance: Every retained family has a complete real business journey with owned persistence, receipt/error behavior and denied access.
Unavailable placeholders are removed only when their replacement has accepted behavior; demo data remains clearly marked.

packages.title: Finish reference/asset adoption and review
packages.note: Remaining app/reference/icon adoption and licensing/localization/accessibility review remain.
acceptance: All required reference items and supported app consumers have accepted disposition/adoption evidence.
No missing asset, duplicate active route or keyboard/screen-reader/contrast/locale regression is introduced; original-assets claims match actual consumers.

packages.title: Run full release acceptance and close batches
packages.note: Full release acceptance depends on the open packages plus actual-device and human evidence.
acceptance: Every retained feature and every batch meets its individual acceptance criteria with current evidence; no unknown/pending result is counted as passed.
Release guard succeeds, production/device/review receipts match the shipped source, and a tested rollback target is retained.

limits: Done means the package's defined acceptance scope passed, not platform-wide authority or feature completion.
R01 completion is limited to the original 192 affected rows; 2494 broader quarantined groups remain unestablished.
Pending means package acceptance is not established; existing foundation components may already exist.
